_comment: THE KVKK ENTITY CHAMPION RECIPE (registry: kvkk50k-labeldiv_gliner25-orig_ddp4_6ep). Full-checkpoint fine-tune of fastino/gliner2.5-multi-v1 on 50k stratified KVKK rows whose label NAMES are diversified (86 aliases, canonical kept at p=0.5; eval stays canonical). 6 epochs = 9,378 steps at EFFECTIVE batch 32: batch_size 8 per process x 4 DDP ranks. On 1 GPU pass --set gradient_accumulation_steps=4 (recipes/train_entities_kvkk.sh does this when NPROC=1). bf16 on the patched library (H100). Result: wording benchmark 0.932 canonical / 0.930 unseen-alias; base of every relations model.
